brief_summary: The aim of this trial is to compare the efficacy and safety of HR17031 versus INS068 and SHR20004 in subjects with type 2 diabetes.
brief_title: A Trial Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of HR17031 Injection to INS068 Injection and to SHR20004 Injection in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: A 26-week, Randomized, Open-label, 3-arm Parallel, Treat-to-target Study Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of HR17031 Injection to INS068 Injection and to SHR20004 Injection in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Inadequately Controlled With Metformin With or Without One Other Oral Anti-diabetic Drug

primary_outcomes.measure: Mean Change From Baseline in HbA1c at Week 26
